topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 185 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 8 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (rolemodule, mintablebasetoken, basetoken). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
